## Appearance

Jonas is a tall, loose-jointed figure distinguished by his absurdly long legs. He has lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, and a big mouth.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)_

## Personality

By this point, Jonas is recognized for his ability to make decisions quickly.

## History

Jonas Blake was a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) graduate and theological student from St. [Columbia](../codex/places.md#columbia) who had initially spent a long time trying to pursue a career outside of the ministry.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)_

## Relationships

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--priscilla-grant.md)
